Management accounting: cash flow and profit per branch

The owner sees the cash in every account and till, a payment calendar for the coming weeks and the real profit of each branch, without waiting for month-end. An MVP in 4–7 weeks, from UZS 60 mln; the full version in 10–18 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

Timeline
MVP 4–7 weeksFull 10–18 weeks
Price
MVP UZS 60–121 mln $5,000–10,000Full UZS 180–425 mln $15,000–35,000Rate: Central Bank of Uzbekistan, 21.10.2026, $1 = UZS 12,012

medium
Who it is for
Any business, Retail, Distribution and wholesale, Restaurants and cafes, Construction, Manufacturing
Integrations

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Cash-flow statement and profit and loss by branch from 1C and bank statements
  • Your own list of management items
  • Payment calendar with planned payments approved in Telegram
  • Daily cash summary in Telegram
What the full version adds
  • Budgets against actuals
  • Several legal entities consolidated
  • Bank APIs where banks offer them
  • Profit per project or contract
  • Forecasts
  • Access by role
Please note

Management accounting sits next to tax accounting in 1C and does not replace your accountant.

What we need from you

  • How the work runs today: who does what
  • Existing data: Excel, notebooks or an old system
  • 1–2 staff to try the system
